notes: Dropped payments, auth, and LLM field-size rows. This product has no accounts or runtime LLM API in v1. Logged as D5.

decisions.decision: EmberDossier is a skill plus a FilePress explainer site, not a PocketBase web app.
decisions.rationale: GENESIS defines a prompting pattern. The site teaches the pattern. No accounts, sync, or shared data in v1.
alternatives_considered: SvelteKit + PocketBase research app that generates dossiers at runtime

decisions.decision: Sample subjects in the skill, site, and GENESIS stay gender-neutral or obviously generic.
decisions.rationale: Owner instruction. Real living people as examples invite bias and go stale. Generic orgs, places, topics, events, or clearly fictional names do the teaching job.
alternatives_considered: Use well-known public figures as running examples

decisions.decision: Publishable prose follows aiBreze. Product speaks as EmberDossier / it.
decisions.rationale: House voice. Site and README are landing surfaces, not essays.

decisions.decision: ForgeTrail MCP-first. Persist `.forgetrail/` only. No vendored `_forgetrail/` tree.
decisions.rationale: Owner asked to start with ForgeTrail. Methodology stays on the server.

decisions.decision: Prune Phase 2 and Phase 7 exit criteria for a skill + static site. Keep archetype product.
decisions.rationale: CRUD, PocketBase, auth, and payments do not apply. Site build, skill load, and docs alignment do.
alternatives_considered: Leave the full-stack template rows and ignore them

decisions.rationale: ember-dossier is taken. emberdossier is blocked by npm similar-name check (punctuation-stripped match). get-ember-dossier@0.0.0 published successfully on 2026-08-19.

decisions.decision: Site depends on published getfilepress from npm, not a sibling link.
decisions.rationale: Owner: FilePress is an npm package. Clones should not need the filepress repo.

decisions.decision: Filled sample is Harborview Public Library: civic, invented, roles not names, operational disputes only.
decisions.rationale: Owner asked for a generic, non-controversial filled dossier. A library renovation teaches all seven sections without picking a news-cycle fight.

decisions.decision: Cloudflare Pages project name is emberdossier. Deploy with pnpm ship.
decisions.rationale: Matches emberdossier.com and the house FilePress ship script (build + wrangler pages deploy).

decisions.decision: Second filled sample is EmberDossier itself. Real, non-controversial, owner-named. /sample is an index of Harborview (invented) and EmberDossier (real).
decisions.rationale: Owner asked for a more complex real example and pointed at emberdossier.com. A self-sample teaches multiple artifacts (format, npm package, site) without a news-cycle fight.
alternatives_considered: A third-party civic or corporate subject

decisions.decision: Third filled sample is Framework Computer. Real, owner-supplied, independent (no affiliation). Founder named because the briefing named that person.
decisions.rationale: Owner asked for another real, mostly non-controversial example. A hardware company with a same-week product launch teaches recency, orbit, and a real controversy section without turning the sample set into news-cycle bait.

gotchas.issue: Cursor MCP still pointed at Z:/workspace/forge-kit after the ForgeTrail rename. Server failed tool discovery until mcp.json used Z:/workspace/forgetrail and FORGETRAIL_ROOT.
gotchas.resolution: Updated ~/.cursor/mcp.json to the forgetrail server. Reload MCP if a session still shows forgekit.

gotchas.issue: npm package name ember-dossier is taken by an unrelated 2017 Ember CLI addon (0.0.3).
filepress check against npm getfilepress@0.1.5 fails without @types/node in the site (svelte-check walks the engine).
gotchas.resolution: Add @types/node as a site devDependency. Sibling link did not need this because the engine workspace already had the types.
